test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The rate of interest p.a. at which a sum becomes three times of itself in 20 years at simple interest will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Sum becomes 3 times of itself

Time (t) = 20 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T) / 100

Total Amount = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

**Calculation:**

Amount = 3 × Principal

Let Principal = P

Simple Interest = Amount - Principal = 3P - P = 2P

SI = P × R × T / 100

⇒ 2P = P × R × 20 / 100

⇒ R = (2P × 100) / (P × 20)

⇒ R = 200 / 20

⇒ R = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
